table.name: nuclear_power_plants
table.purpose: Catalog of individual nuclear power reactors worldwide, one row per reactor unit, with location, reactor type/model, capacity, lifecycle dates, status, and data provenance. Sources include WNA (World Nuclear Association), IAEA, and Wikipedia.

Capacity.name: net_capacity_mw
Capacity.description: Reactor unit's electrical capacity in megawatts (net MW). Empty string for units without a stated capacity (e.g., planned/cancelled). Values like 950, 1000, 1340, 18 (KNK-II, a small prototype FBR) fit MW ratings.

ConstructionStartAt.name: construction_start_date
ConstructionStartAt.description: Date construction of the reactor began (ISO date, often month precision). Empty for units never built.

Country.name: country
Country.description: Country where the reactor is located, using formal names (e.g., 'People's Republic of China', 'Korea, Republic of').

Id.name: id
Id.description: Primary key; unique numeric identifier for each reactor row.

LastUpdatedAt.name: last_updated_at
LastUpdatedAt.description: Timestamp (ISO 8601 with timezone) when the row was last updated in the dataset. Empty in some rows.

Latitude.name: latitude
Latitude.description: Decimal degrees latitude of the reactor site. Empty in some rows.

Longitude.name: longitude
Longitude.description: Decimal degrees longitude of the reactor site. Empty in some rows.

Name.name: reactor_name
Name.description: Name of the reactor unit, typically site name plus unit number (e.g., 'Hope Creek-1', 'Shin-Kori-4'). Unique across rows.

OperationalFrom.name: operational_from
OperationalFrom.description: Date the reactor started commercial operation (first grid connection/commissioning). Empty for units not yet operating.

OperationalTo.name: operational_to
OperationalTo.description: Date the reactor ceased operation (shutdown/decommissioning date). Empty for units still operating or never operated.

ReactorModel.name: reactor_model
ReactorModel.description: Specific reactor design/model (e.g., 'BWR-4 (Mark 1)', 'APR-1400', 'VVER V-320', 'MAGNOX'). Empty in some rows.

ReactorType.name: reactor_type
ReactorType.description: Broad reactor technology category code: PWR, BWR, PHWR, GCR (gas-cooled), LWGR (RBMK), FBR (fast breeder), HWLWR, HWGCR, HTGR, etc.

Source.name: source
Source.description: Data provenance: which references the row's data came from — WNA (World Nuclear Association), IAEA, wikipedia, or combinations.

Status.name: status
Status.description: Current lifecycle status of the unit: Operational, Shutdown, Planned, Under Construction, Suspended Construction, or Cancelled Construction.
